branch_comparison.interpretation: Recorded as a branch comparison only; plus/minus equality is not required for the evaluator contract.

claim_boundary: This proves only that this Figure 21 right-side modular evaluator run completes for the two rank-2 semion branches and agrees with the pointed evaluator on the evaluated sectors.
non_claims: This is not a formal low-rank scan aggregate.
This is not a complete exotic-pair comparison; only the Figure 21 right-side input is evaluated.
This does not certify the Figure 21 transcription against the printed paper.
This does not evaluate nonpointed categories or categories with trivial universal group.
This does not prove TCY or low-rank MTCs cannot detect exotic pairs.
purpose: Evaluate the Figure 21 right-side Morse input on the smallest rank-2 modular categories with nontrivial universal group, and cross-check the modular killing-loop evaluator against the pointed graph-level evaluator sector by sector.
